scope: Independent review criteria for F1/F2 correction only; no operational/floor/GA acceptance

criteria.must_show: A real accepted-source RuntimeControl admission composition reaches successful Construction admission, then an actual final control.check failure before SnapshotAdoptionScope exists. Cancellation originates at that exact boundary; deadline originates there with actual carried origin. Do not inject a prebuilt failure or substitute a caller bool for the control check.
criteria.counterexample: A scope-finalizer success test or cancellation before the first admission never reaches the uncovered original control.rs:684-704 exit.
criteria.proof: Exact source preimage, boundary mechanism, assertions on construction ticket/usage and full primary failure fields, host outputs for both causes. Any test hook is explicitly test-only and recorded.

criteria.must_show: Failure before Construction admission preserves original body/source/metadata destruction/refund order, original primary failure, and truthful after_cleanup without creating selected scope authority.
criteria.counterexample: Cleanup logic assumes a construction ticket exists or runs selected retirement for a branch that never admitted it.
criteria.proof: An actual pre-Construction refusal with source/metadata already live, plus a branch before those tickets, and corresponding output/accounting.

criteria.must_show: Name every early ingress, selector, scope/Result/Option, error, returned failure, move, destructor, cleanup-call and caller place newly introduced by the exact final source. Classify which actual values are consumed before a narrowing and which remain live through original finish and return. The ordinary Original base, including only explicitly reviewed common-core additions, still covers every surviving place.
criteria.counterexample: Passing unit, an empty Option, a layout witness, a clone, a different object, or only part of the early state to retirement while the real error/return object survives. Drop of T does not prove drop of other live values.
criteria.proof: Source-place map to exact source lines and actual consuming ownership paths. A retained Result/error/caller place must be included in the retained floor or force the conservative retained-charge outcome.

criteria.must_show: Healthy pre-scope cleanup narrows the actual same Construction ticket only after all extra selected storage has actually been destroyed, then uses unchanged original finish_owned_cleanup. Alternatively leave the enlarged charge and genuine ConstructionBound or other actual invariant visible and label that branch unqualified for healthy cleanup.
criteria.counterexample: finish accepts Snapshot-sized bytes as a second floor, a caller supplies a desired bound, equality of mutable ticket.bytes authenticates a profile, or a new RuntimeControl discriminator repairs the omission.
criteria.proof: Original finish body unchanged; no alternate byte-only floor or RuntimeControl field; full after-cleanup current/peak/live ticket/invariant assertions.

criteria.must_show: Actual early storage is destroyed before retirement validation. Missing ticket, wrong owner/category, invalid bound, and/or underflow cannot counterfeit healthy zero. A cleanup error/invariant remains separately attributable and never replaces the original cancellation/deadline/resource failure payload.
criteria.counterexample: Using ? on retirement returns its error as the primary failure, or calling record_cleanup replaces the failure captured at final admission check.
criteria.proof: At least one actual corrupted retirement boundary, with storage destruction witness, original primary comparison excluding the newly attached after_cleanup, and genuine retained usage/invariant. Source audit covers all validation refusals.

criteria.must_show: The concrete actual phase admission result retains a usable shared reborrow to the same original RuntimeControl in both admitted and refused variants. A failed Result<Phase<'c>, Error> followed by fallback borrowing the original control is not assumed valid.
criteria.counterexample: Option<Phase> as_ref() then unwrap_or(control), or a refused direct control borrow while the original exclusive phase borrow is still needed by completion.
criteria.proof: Compile the exact actual accepted-source guard/control/phase composition for both branches; preserve an independent negative E0502 for the direct fallback relation.

criteria.must_show: The same sole InitialProfileBorrowV1 literal receives the phase's shared reborrow. Export/header/rows derive only from it. Every guard-derived reference/view/iterator and relevant File borrow ends before the actual phase is consumed through complete.
criteria.counterexample: A second guard literal for refusal, deriving a reference from initial then dropping only the guard, or retaining a guard-derived view through consuming complete.
criteria.proof: Actual-source positive admitted and refused composition in Debug and optimized modes, negative live-view E0505 or equivalent precise compiler rejection, source audit of literal cardinality and all exit paths.

criteria.must_show: Export admission refusal retains the exact export diagnostic and leaves first_failure/ledger/counters unchanged. It still reaches original header then rows, subject to original header refusal. Existing first failure is read/copied exactly. Refusal consumes no nonexistent exporter storage and mints no second owner, guard, ticket, cancellation handle, or callback authority.
criteria.counterexample: Returning early on export admission refusal, terminal owner/check helpers during diagnostic admission, or a refusal owner that evades later consuming original cleanup.
criteria.proof: Exact branch/source comparison against accepted wrapper and real admitted/refused assertions; do not call stand-in compiler controls actual wrapper behavior.

criteria.must_show: Measure exact newly introduced error/Result/Option/reborrow/argument/return/move/retirement places in unit Debug, unit optimized, ordinary-production Debug, and ordinary-production optimized with source preimages and toolchain/target recorded. Layout sums remain conservative named-object models, never physical stack/RSS claims.
criteria.counterexample: Size of one error type or RuntimeControl alone is called complete floor; unit Debug is treated as unit optimized; recorded LLVM constants lack the exact compiled source manifest.
criteria.proof: Four context-specific compiler receipts/constants, independently decoded sizes and alignments, complete source-place coverage or explicit partial status. No proposed bytes become a grant.

criteria.must_show: Original eight discriminants and inline primary payloads/order remain; original policy ceilings/budgets remain; one source-authored admission core and one Construction ticket remain. Only allowed candidate additions change; accepted144, original70, prior independent35 stay byte-identical.
criteria.counterexample: A successful prototype admission or layout probe is reported as full writer acceptance, or an ordinary profile overhead changes silently.
criteria.proof: Pinned member revalidation, exact patched source diffs, unchanged-signature/ceiling comparisons, candid ordinary-profile and retained-branch limitations.

evidence_boundaries: A compile establishes type/lifetime feasibility in its exact source context only.
A reduced ownership probe cannot establish actual RuntimeControl admission, payload accounting, wrapper/File behavior, or a complete runtime floor.
Source-only or layout-only closure remains partial when executable actual-path evidence is absent.
No native, simulator, emulator, UI, capture, process inventory, frozen wrapper replay, hosted harness, Android v5, or interpreter-startup closure is permitted.
